item.description: Pact Group is at the forefront of Australia’s and New Zealand’s packaging future. But regulations are changing and Pact wants to stay at the forefront. The company embraced traceability early, planning for emerging regulatory requirements, while reinforcing its industry leadership and deepening trust with customers and retailers.

item.title: [Video] ContiTech's Global Manufacturing Transformation with SAP Digital Manufacturing
item.description: How do you build a scalable manufacturing template that can be rolled out globally?In this customer success story, ContiTech shares how it partnered with IGZ to implement SAP Digital Manufacturing and enable full traceability, standardized processes, and faster deployments across its production network.Starting with a greenfield facility in Aguascalientes, Mexico, ContiTech set out to build a modern Manufacturing Execution System (MES), develop a reusable template for future plant deployments, and transition from SAP Manufacturing Execution (SAP ME) to SAP Digital Manufacturing.

item.title: [Video] Deliver Flawless Field Service and Asset Maintenance with AI
item.description: In this webinar hosted by Supply Chain Brain, explore how leading organizations are connecting asset maintenance and field service using AI, predictive technologies, and real-time asset insights. Learn how companies are optimizing maintenance and service operations, guiding technicians with intelligent recommendations, and orchestrating end-to-end processes across supply chain, service execution, and finance.Discover how integrated asset maintenance and field service powered by AI enables organizations to move from reactive repairs to proactive and outcome-based service models—where asset performance, uptime, customer satisfaction, and profitability are directly connected.Customer expectations for uptime, reliability, and service quality are higher than ever. At the same time, organizations are managing increasingly complex assets, aging infrastructure, and growing pressure to improve efficiency and profitability.

item.title: [Video] Migros: Unifying Supply Planning and Advancing Sustainability with SAP Premium Services & Support
item.description: Migros, Switzerland’s leading retailer and manufacturer, partnered with SAP Services & Support to implement SAP Integrated Business Planning as part of its Project One move to SAP S/4HANA. By consolidating planning data from legacy systems into a single platform, Migros now orchestrates its 16,000-product portfolio with shared, granular planning that optimizes manufacturing resources and boosts efficiency across IT and the business—reducing overall costs. With SAP best practices, direct access to product managers, and ongoing system health checks, Migros continuously improves system performance and planning strategies. Next, the partners are exploring generative AI to elevate planner productivity, increase forecast accuracy, and further cut food waste.

item.title: [Article] Optimizing mobile intralogistics with a certified add-on for SAP solutions that supports a clean core

item.title: [Video] Illumina Technology: Automating logistics to deliver time-critical health diagnostics
item.description: Genomic sequencing drives breakthroughs in rare disease diagnosis, oncology treatment, and clinical research, but discoveries mean nothing if products don’t arrive on time. Illumina Technology eliminated manual, paper-based transportation planning with the SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM) application and SAP Business Network for Logistics. The company automated carrier coordination to ensure temperature-sensitive diagnostics reach hospitals and laboratories when delays of hours or even days can mean the difference between life and death

Facing a short timeline and the need for a robust, future-proof solution, Siemens Gamesa turned to Syntax for guidance in selecting and implementing SAP’s cloud-native platform. The seamless integration with SAP ERP enabled efficient data exchange, process synchronization, and enhanced traceability across production. With Syntax’s expertise and a strong template-based approach, Siemens Gamesa achieved a rapid rollout across 16 plants worldwide, driving efficiency, transparency, and alignment with long-term business goals.
